regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (no regional blocks or locator map)
regions.notes: Sorghum harvest drawn as Jan + Dec pieces, merged to Dec-Jan. Green harvest (mid-Jun-Jul and Sep) skipped. Two lean boxes labelled South and North; no map defines them.

assign.method: Single-region calendar (no titled blocks): every prefecture mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: 2024+ template: element edges sit on a half-month grid; a month that is exactly half covered counts (>= half rule). Planting starts mid-Mar (Mar counted, exactly half). Lean South = Apr to mid-Jun; Lean North = mid-Jun to mid-Sep (Jun cover ~0.45, Sep ~0.49, both counted) so June appears in both lean seasons. The North/South split of the lean season is not mapped on the image, so it is NOT reflected in assign.
